changelog: First community release: share lists, global recommendations, and Neighbour Dog.
release_notes: The welcome tour greets you by name, then shows your 5 latest posts.
Each report is a Page. The neighbours picture is on that Page.
Every report says how long it should take and notifies you when it is ready.
Only a direct reply to your post counts, and likes on your own replies are not fetched.
Community sharing stays off until you opt in.
A Monday check asks before any upgrade, and it never upgrades on its own.
